title: YouTube Appears in 53% of Google AI Overviews for Vitamin and Supplement Searches
summary: Research by Searcherries reveals that YouTube is the most frequently cited source in Google AI Overviews for vitamin and supplement searches, appearing in 53.1% of 350 analyzed AI-generated answers. This demonstrates the growing importance of video content in AI-powered search results.
problem_solved: Reveals how AI search algorithms prioritize and source content for health-related queries, particularly video content.
why_valuable: Provides actionable insights for content creators and marketers about the significance of video content in AI-driven search visibility and SEO strategy.
